LESSON: CAPACITY

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.3: Capacity

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Capacity. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-1/mathematics/page-173.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1 — page 173]]

From your pupil's book (page 173)

MEASUREMENT CAPACITY Week 7 Lesson 1 Measuring capacity Activity Which holds more than, less than or same as

Sufuria Jug Basin The sufuria holds more than a jug. The jug holds less than a sufuria. The sufuria holds same as a basin. Work to do Which holds more than, less than or same as The jerrycan ______ the bottle

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-1/mathematics/page-061.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1 — page 61]]

From your pupil's book (page 61)

TERM 1 Week 9 Lesson 5 Measuring capacity Activity How many?

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-1/mathematics/page-122.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1 — page 122]]

From your pupil's book (page 122)

TERM 2 Week 9 Lesson 2 Measuring capacity Activity How many? Fill the bottle and pour into the basin. Count the number of bottles needed to fill the basin. Repeat with the jug.

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Capacity means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Capacity.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Capacity
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
